questions: Have you had surgery on your head recently?
Was the surgery due to an injury?
Have you experienced headaches or dizziness?
Is there any fluid leaking from the area?
results: 1. family history: mother, sister and grandmother affected - autosomal dominant pattern
2. genetic testing (targeted panel or exome): novel heterozygous NONSENSE variant in POU4F1; present in the symptomatic mother, sister and grandmother and absent in a healthy uncle
3. brain MRI: significant cerebellar atrophy with dilatation of the fourth ventricle
4. lumbar puncture / CSF: no oligoclonal bands - against multiple sclerosis
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: POU4F1-associated multisystem neurodegenerative disorder (characterized by autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia, sensory neuropathy, and optic atrophy).

Spinocerebellar ataxia (SCA)
Multiple system atrophy (MSA)
Mitochondrial neurodegenerative disorder
